title: Onyx Storm
author: Rebecca Yarros
summary: The third book in the Empyrean series moves beyond the college and sends its riders on a dangerous mission across unfamiliar lands to find allies. The war is coming whether they are ready or not.
readIf: you are caught up in the series and want its bigger-scale, quest-driven chapter.
skipIf: you haven't read the earlier books or want a finished, standalone story.

pairings.reason: The second book, which sets up the stakes this one escalates.
A standalone epic with dragons, a large world and several story lines for a more complete read.
A similar war-and-romance arc where a love story gets caught up in an invasion.
